I.Consideratii tehnice - Pentru situtiile in care, potrivit procedurilor legale de reconstituire a dreptului de proprietate in favoarea proprietarilor persoane fizice, proceduri care au fost puse in aplicare de catre Comisiile Locale de Fond Funciar, tehnicilie si tehnologiile de efectuare a ridicarilor topografice, si cu atat mai mult a trasarilor topografice, au fost aproximative si caracterizate de erori de pozitionare foarte mari, acest fapt conducand la pozitionarea parcelelor cu un nivel foarte ridicat de aproximare, se impune ca aceste operatiuni tehnice sa se refaca in acord cu ultimele reglementari tehnice din domeniul masuratorilor terestre; - prestatia tehnica de trasare topografica se va efectua in acord cu documentele cadastrale avizate si receptionate de OCPI, mai precis se vor trasa puncte al caror inventar de coordonate este validat definitiv prin natura tipului de lucrare in prealabil realizat, cum ar fi: plan parcelar, cadastru sistematic etc. - sa vor trasa topografic, folosind tehnologie clasica sau tehnologie GNSS, acele puncte care definesc fronturile stradale ale fiecarei parcele (pe laturile mici / pe latime), in cazul unor imobile cu geometrie dreptunghiulara sau de-a lungul intregului perimetru, in cazul imobilelor cu geometrie neregulata; totodata, se vor amplasa tarusi din lemn pentru fiecare parcela de teren. - precizia de determinare a punctelor ce vor fi trasate este de max +/-5 cm. - concomitent cu derularea operatiunilor de teren, vom redact
Awardee: Coman Dragos Mihai

Preliminary Inquiry (PI) to identify and select companies that are interested in and capable to provide maintenance services for the water treatment plant and water transportation services for the ALMA Observatory, located close to San Pedro de Atacama, Chile. The scope of the services includes 2 lots: Lot 1: Water transportation services, including: - Transportation of potable water required for the operation of the Observatory from Calama and/or San Pedro de Atacama. - Transportation of Industrial water from Calama and/or San Pedro de Atacama to the Observatory. Lot 2: Water treatment plant maintenance, including: - Operation and maintenance of the water treatment plant. - Sanitising of water storage tanks. - Corrective maintenance of the potable water distribution pipes and wastewater pipes. - Extraction from pits, sludge removal, cleaning of grease chambers, supply and cleaning of chemical toilets. - Analysis of potable and waste water according to the norm Nch 409 and NCh 1333. - Testing and certification of sludge from the water treatment plant. The contract will start on the 1st of January 2021 for a firm period of 3 years, with the option to extend it by up to 2 more years. The Preliminary Inquiry is expected to be issued in Q1 2020 to potential suppliers in Chile, and will be followed by a Call for Tender that is scheduled to be released in Q2 2020. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q4 2020, to the Bidder, which has submitted a fully compliant Tender and offers the lowest price. Scheduled/Status:
